scope: Declared dry isothermal 298 K, 1 bar post-reactor gas conditioning, initially all observed NOx assigned to NO; not measured speciation or absorption
rate_source: IUPAC NOx23 preferred 298 K; log10 reliability +-0.2, not statistical confidence or universal kinetic enclosure
conditions: Only gas-phase 2NO+O2->2NO2 and arbitrary allowed NO2/N2O4 partition; no leaks, walls, water or absorption; steady inventories; negligible kinetic energy; imposed isothermal state requires heat removal. Pressure held constant, hydraulic work not identified. All 20 SLM is original feed. No high-pressure extrapolation is admitted.
